title: App Studio vs Dev Studio - Quiz
description: Test your understanding of PEGA's two development environments and when to use each

questions.question: Which development environment is designed primarily for business users?
questions.explanation: App Studio is designed primarily for business users, citizen developers, and those new to PEGA development with its low-code, visual approach.

questions.question: Dev Studio provides access to all PEGA rules and features.
questions.explanation: True. Dev Studio is the comprehensive development environment that provides complete access to all PEGA rules and features with advanced configuration options.

questions.question: What is a key characteristic of App Studio's approach?
options: Complete access to all system features
questions.explanation: App Studio uses guided workflows and wizards to help users through development processes, making it accessible to non-technical users.

questions.question: A business analyst needs to quickly create a prototype application to demonstrate a concept. Which tool should they use?
questions.explanation: App Studio is ideal for rapid prototyping due to its guided approach, pre-built templates, and business-friendly interface that enables quick application creation.

questions.question: When would you need to use Dev Studio instead of App Studio?
questions.explanation: Dev Studio is necessary for complex integrations that require custom connector development, advanced error handling, and detailed system configuration.

questions.question: App Studio has a steeper learning curve than Dev Studio.
questions.explanation: False. App Studio has a gentler learning curve and is designed for non-technical users, while Dev Studio has a steeper learning curve requiring technical knowledge.

questions.question: Which environment provides advanced debugging tools and performance monitoring?
questions.explanation: Dev Studio provides advanced debugging tools, performance monitoring, and diagnostic features that are not available in App Studio's simplified interface.

questions.question: A professional developer needs to configure advanced security settings and system administration tasks. Which tool is appropriate?
questions.explanation: Dev Studio is required for advanced security configuration, system administration, and detailed system settings that are not accessible through App Studio.

questions.question: What is the best practice for tool selection in PEGA development?
options: Always use Dev Studio for everything
Always use App Studio for everything
Start with App Studio and switch to Dev Studio when needed
Use only one tool per project
questions.explanation: Best practice is to start with App Studio to leverage guided workflows and best practices, then switch to Dev Studio when you encounter limitations or need advanced features.

questions.question: Both App Studio and Dev Studio can be used collaboratively in the same project.
questions.explanation: True. Both tools can be used collaboratively in the same project, with business users working in App Studio while developers use Dev Studio for advanced features.
